rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose verb for removing hair with a razor or clippers; use 剃鬚 when you specifically mean facial hair.

example.english: I shave my leg hair myself in the morning.
example.jyutping: ngo5 ziu1 zou2 zi6 gei2 tai3 goek3 mou4

rows.note: Use this specifically for shaving facial hair; 剃 is broader and can refer to removing hair anywhere.

example.english: I shave my facial hair before leaving the house.
example.jyutping: ngo5 ceot1 mun4 hau2 zi1 cin4 wui5 tai3 sou1
